This is a stage-invariant mismatch, not evidence that exact merge itself is wrong.

TARGET_MEASURED pilot also exposed structured-output exactness failure (extra Markdown fence), one-sentence compliance failure in a Hyperposition case, and confused/inaccurate lock/rekey language, while database-vs-simulation preference and exact-three-apples instruction behavior showed useful positives.

Producer-attestation design should separate authenticated envelope bytes from trust/key policy. A DSSE-style envelope can authenticate payload+payloadType, but keyid is only an unauthenticated hint and key management/trust binding is external; therefore self-declared producer/key identifiers must never become authority.

2026 activation-patching research shows natural indirect effects can contain mediator interaction effects; large single-site effects can be prompt/context dependent or inflated. J-Space promotion therefore needs interaction diagnostics for top sites/layers, not only independent single-site interventions.
